props.name: Scale
props.expression: amp = 0.08;     // bounce amountfreq = 1.0;     // bounce speeddecay = 6.0;    // how fast it stopsn = 0;if (numKeys > 0){    n = nearestKey(time).index;    if (key(n).time > time){        n--;    }}if (n == 0){    value;}else{    t = time - key(n).time;    v = velocityAtTime(key(n).time - thisComp.frameDuration/10);    value + v * amp * Math.sin(freq * t * 2 * Math.PI) / Math.exp(decay * t);}

props.name: Opacity
props.expression: var t = time - inPoint;var duration = 1;if (t <= 0) {    0;} else if (t < duration) {    var flicker = Math.sin(t * 70) * 50 + 50;    var progress = t / duration;    var result = flicker * (1 - progress) + 100 * progress;    Math.max(0, Math.min(100, result));} else {    100;}
